risks: Admin Analytics still consumes broad historical and realtime route payloads before every module has a dedicated verified snapshot contract.
Some module normalizers carry source classification locally instead of through one shared source metadata helper.
GA4 intraday and realtime provider data can be mistaken for stable final truth if labels are missing.
Firestore cached snapshots can be shown before server confirmation if listener metadata is not surfaced.
Guest-to-user identity linkage must preserve guest history and exclude admin/system events from user analytics.
Legacy route snapshots and local session storage snapshots must be labeled as stale/cache, never live.

phase5.name: admin_analytics_snapshot_migration
rules: Admin Analytics renders verified snapshot metadata first when available.
Realtime and historical routes are upgrade or compatibility paths, not blank-loading dependencies.
Manual refresh uses /api/admin/analytics/refresh and keeps stale verified snapshots visible.
Full parity, formula, source, legacy, and validation proof belongs in Admin Debug.
